points: Your site shows 1659 reviews, yet 0 of 25 ads carry a proof number, so new buyers have nothing to trust before clicking. Put the 1659 figure on the creative and open two ads with review quotes.

25 of 25 ads open on Miracle results at half the price, so every buyer hears the same discount hook first. Name two new angles from your range, like the Coily leave-in or Blow Dry Shield, and test each against the opener.

One exact copy runs in all 25 ads, so the same words go out every time with nothing new to compare. Keep the offer copy, but change the opening line and creative in each ad so each one tests something new.
All 25 ads started within the last 10 days, so none has run long enough to judge. Pick the ad you want to keep and build three variations of it, changing one thing in each.
